==> modules.mk (generated, modules-mk) <==
# modules.mk: the build units in link order and each C unit's compiler, generated by romlift.
OBJS := \
	build/rom_header.o \
	build/crt0.o \
	build/asm_080000F4.o \
	build/data.o
C_OBJS :=
EXPECTED_OBJS := \
	build/expected/rom_header.o \
	build/expected/crt0.o \
	build/expected/asm_080000F4.o \
	build/expected/data.o
# make debug: the ELF with DWARF debug information for the C modules, its bytes checked against the ROM (D124).
DEBUG_OBJS := $(patsubst build/src/%.o,build/debug/src/%.o,$(OBJS))
.PHONY: debug
debug: build/debug/$(NAME).elf
build/debug/$(NAME).elf: $(ROM) FORCE
	@mkdir -p $(@D)
	sed 's|build/src/|build/debug/src/|g' ldscript.txt > build/debug/ldscript.txt
	$(LD) -T build/debug/ldscript.txt -o $@ $(DEBUG_OBJS)
	$(OBJCOPY) -O binary $@ build/debug/$(NAME).gba
	@cmp build/debug/$(NAME).gba $(ROM) || { echo "$@: its bytes are not $(ROM)'s, so its addresses are not the ROM's (-g changed the code a compiler wrote)" >&2; rm -f $@; exit 1; }
